name: jahunkoo-skills
description: Agent skills by Jahun Koo, each published with its evaluation evidence.

plugins.name: critique-with-alternatives
plugins.description: Reviews a plan or a risky request against your repository before anything runs, and hands back a better way for each flaw it finds. When you ask for a review, it stops at the review instead of making the change.

plugins.name: distill
plugins.description: Removes outdated history from agent instructions, keeping only what the agent should do now. Reports first and edits only after you approve.
